summary: Adds parseCurrencyString with error handling and rounding logic but provides no tests for any of its paths.

findings.message: parseCurrencyString has no test coverage; the NaN error branch, rounding edge cases (e.g. '$1.005'), and comma-separated values are all untested.
findings.suggestion: Add unit tests: parseCurrencyString('$1,234.56') === 123456, parseCurrencyString('abc') throws, and a rounding boundary case.
